failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Which NFL athlete was drafted, played for the New York Jets two years after being drafted, and was re-acquired by the New York Jets during the 2015 NFL season?' This is a natural-language yes/no question format rather than a structured entity-focused query.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 query: 'Which New York Jets player was drafted, played for the team approximately two years after being drafted, and was subsequently re-acquired by the Jets during the 2015 NFL season?' Another natural-language question rather than a retrieval-optimized query targeting specific entities or facts.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query asks 'Which NFL athlete was drafted, played for the New York Jets two years after being drafted, and was re-acquired by the New York Jets during the 2015 NFL season?' and Hop 3 query asks nearly identically 'Which New York Jets player was drafted, played for the team approximately two years after being drafted, and was subsequently re-acquired by the Jets during the 2015 NFL season?' Both queries ask the same compound question with only minor wording variations, failing to advance the search strategy.

failure_modes.name: Missing_Evidence_Not_Specified
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 states: 'To fully verify this claim, the following information would be required: 1. Identification of the specific athlete being referenced (full name and identifying details)' but does not name a specific missing athlete entity.
